Commentary.Commentary: So that's it from all of us here for this game. We hope you enjoyed our coverage. We look forward to your company for the third and final T20I between the two sides on 22nd February at the Adelaide Oval. Action begins 1920 local (0850 GMT). Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Sri Lanka skipper, Upul Tharanga starts off thanking the crowd for their support. Calls it an amazing innings from Asela, mentions that he did well in SA too. Opines that wicket had spongy bounce, they lost too many wickets early but Asela concentrated well enough and finished the game. Calls the win against Australia exciting as they are a young side and calls it a huge achievement. Ends by saying that they are looking forward to the warm weather in Adelaide as it is really cold here (in Geelong).

Australia skipper Aaron Finch, calls Gunaratne's knock a hell of an innings. Agrees that the execution wasn't well from his bowlers in the end. Feels for Henriques too who gave away 22 runs in the penultimate over. Credits Sri Lanka for playing well. He informs that they had enough runs to win the match. Ends by stating that he is looking forward to Adelaide calling it a beautiful place to play cricket.
Man of the Match, Asela Gunaratne, says this is the happiest he's felt in his life.

Australia will be disappointed with the loss, they had the Lankans on the mat but failed to close the game out in time. They have lost second T20I series in a row at home and despite the absence of star players, they will think they should have done better. Coming to the game, every bowler began well for them but lack of wickets during the later half of the game cost them. Andrew Tye was the best bowler, well in terms of wickets, taking 3/37, but sadly for him, he could not defend 13 in the last over and that was it for the hosts.

And to think Sri Lanka were 40/5 at one stage, tells you how brilliantly they played. The top order was seen off before they could blink. Chamara Kapugedera and Asela Gunaratne added 52 runs for the sixth wicket before the former departed. Asela though, did not miss out and registered his fifty, he raised his game just in time to ensure the visitors finished the job on hand.

What a game of cricket! Sri Lanka needed 36 from 11 balls when Asela Gunaratne got stuck into Moises Henriques scoring 22 runs in the next five balls to bring the visitors back in the game. With 14 needed in the last over, Asela hit 4 and then a 6 to get ahead in the game. 2 were needed in 1 ball when Asela Gunaratne hit a boundary to seal not just the win but also the series for them with a game to go.

FOUR! Outstanding victory for the Lankans. Length delivery from Tye, outside off, Gunaratne drives it over covers for boundary and seals the series with that. In come the Sri Lankan players to rejoice the win. Tye cannot believe it. Australia's poor run in T20Is continue. Jeez, what a thriller! SRI LANKA WIN BY 2 WICKETS!
Tension, tension in the air! 2 needed in 1.
Length ball, slower delivery, Malinga flicks it uppishly through square leg for a single. Now then, 2 off 1 and all three results possible here.
Fullish delivery, on middle, Gunaratne flicks it through square leg for a single. And now Malinga is on strike. 3 off 2 balls. Can Tye bowl a dot ball or scalp a wicket?
Lasith Malinga wants to calm down Asela.
SIX! Length ball, around off, Gunaratne shuffles across and lofts it straight down the ground. Has a bit to say to Tye too. This man has gone bonkers. Can he seal the series here for his side?
FOUR! Horrid delivery. Full toss around off, Gunaratne waits for it and smokes it over mid off for a boundary. 10 off 4 balls.
Lasith Malinga is the new man in. He won't be on strike though. Sri Lanka need 14 more in 5 balls.

OUT! Length ball, around off, NK looks to go over covers but mistimes. The ball goes high in the air and Klinger goes back a bit, gets under it to take a comfortable catch near covers. But crucially for Sri Lanka, Gunaratne is back on strike.
Tye again has the rights for the final over. 14 runs needed from the last over.
FOUR! Fullish ball, Gunaratne drives it over covers for a boundary. Wow, he's changed the game altogether. 14 needed off the last over.
The batsman tries to pull that one but failed to connect it.
SIX! Gunaratne is on a roll! Length delivery, Gunaratne shuffles a bit and pulls it over the fine leg fence. Suddenly, the Australians are feeling the pressure.
SIX! And another! Length delivery, around off, Gunaratne moves across and smokes it over the deep mid-wicket fence. Are we in for something here?
2nd T20I fifty for Asela Gunaratne!
SIX! Wow. That's a beaut. Fuller delivery, outside off, Gunaratne moves ahead a bit and smacks it over covers for a maximum.

Fuller delivery, on middle, Gunaratne looks to flick it away but gets a bottom edge onto his pads which almost goes back towards Henriques but it falls just short of him. Think he should've gone for the catch, but backed out at the very last minute. Maybe he wanted to save a single.
Moises Henriques to bowl the penultimate over.
The batsman gets a bottom edge of the bat on that one. One run added to the total.
Kulasekara punches it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Length ball, around leg, NK moves across and tickles it very fine for another boundary. 10 off the last 4 balls.
FOUR! Much needed for the Lankans! Full delivery, around off, Kulasekara drives it with complete authority over covers for a boundary.
Length delivery, around off, Gunaratne shuffles across looking to drag but mistimes it towards fine leg for a single.
Yorker length delivery, NK jams it towards the off side and runs one. Faulkner chases it looking to effect a run out but slips.
Kulasekara lofts this fullish delivery towards long on. But it falls well short of the fielder. They run a single.
Length ball, around off, Kulasekara looks to drive it down the ground but gets beaten.
Thick inside edge by the batsman, ball goes down to fine Leg. They pick up a single.
Slower delivery, on a length, outside off, Gunaratne drives it uppishly over point and runs a couple. There was a fielder present there, but it landed safe.
Length delivery, way outside off, Gunaratne swings and misses. Wonder why wasn't that called a wide? Certainly looked like one.
Attempted yorker, Gunaratne tries to flick it using his wrists, but only manages to get an inside edge onto his pads.
Andrew Tye returns for his final spell.
Length delivery, outside off, Gunaratne moves back and ends up chasing it. It hits the toe end of the bat and rolls towards third man. One run added to the total.
Slower one, NK picks it up early, waits for it and punches it towards mid-wicket. They run a single.
Faulkner bowls a back of a length delivery, nips it back in, Gunaratne pulls it unconvincingly through mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball, around middle and leg, Gunaratne goes back wanting to cut but misses.
Nuwan Kulasekara is the new man in.

OUT! Faulkner makes amends, he was not impressed with the boundary whatsoever. Bangs it short again, Prasanna tries to pull but top edges it to Head near fine leg who takes a fine catch. Sri Lanka need 55 off 28 balls.

FOUR! Back of a length delivery, around off, Prasanna swivels across and pulls it hard towards fine leg for a boundary. Head hares across from long leg but it the ball beats him easily. Good start to the over.
James Faulkner is back into the attack.
Back of a length on off, worked towards square leg for a single. Sri Lanka need 59 more in 30 balls.
Shorter in length on the stumps, SP misses his pull shot and is beaten. A wide is signaled for the height.
On a length on off, Seekkuge looks to clip it through mid-wicket but gets it off the top half just towards the on side.
Slower one outside off, dragged through mid-wicket for a single.
Sprays it wide outside off, AG comes down to have a go but misses.
Bowls it on a length on the stumps, Seekkuge looks to deflect it through but misses. He acts as if the ball has not touched anything and he gets a wide for it along with the extra run.
BEATEN! Outside off on a length, Prasanna looks to hit it on the up but is beaten all ends up.
Slower one on around off, SP gets behind it and defends it.
Moises Henriques brought back on.
Shorter in length outside off, Gunaratne opens the face of the bat and gets it down to third man for a brace. Faulkner was the one doing the fielding in the deep.
Fuller outside off, hit through cover-point for a single.
Outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single.
FOUR! The boundaries are coming! Short this time around the stumps, Asela goes for the pull through square leg. Dunk gets around to stop it but the timing was too good and he gets a boundary.
SIX! Up and over! A cutter on the stumps, Asela gets across and swings it over the short fine leg for a maximum.
On a length around off, Seekkuge looks to clip it but is beaten and rapped on his pads. The bowler appeals but not out.
Jhye Richardson called back on for a bowl.
Short outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single by SP. Sri Lanka need 79 more in 42 balls.
WIDE! Bangs it short outside off, Prasanna looks to go after it but misses his pull shot. Given a wide for the height on that one, the bowler does not like it, they never do.
There is a slip in place.
Short ball outside off, Asela controls his pull through backward square leg for a single.
Hurls it on a length on the stumps, Gunaratne looks to give himself room and carve it through the off side but is beaten as the ball bounces over the stumps.
Seekkuge Prasanna is the new man in.

OUT! Top catch! Slower ball on the stumps, Kapugedera looks to go over mid off and seems to have done well. Ben Dunk running back from mid off, leaps up just in time to take the catch. That's a superb grab from the southpaw. The stand is broken at last and Cummins has his  first wicket.
Hurls it outside off on a length, Chamara fails to connect with his slash through the off side.
50-run stand comes up between Asela Gunaratne and Chamara Kapugedera.

FOUR! Just wide! Length ball outside off, Chamara backs away and looks for an early boundary. He gets it off the edge wide of the keeper for a boundary. Unlucky Pat, he has had quite a few of those to the fence.
Pat Cummins comes back into the attack.
Shorter outside off, Asela backs away and carves it behind backward point for a couple of runs.
Slower ball again on a length, dabbed down to third man for a single.
Length ball outside off, Chamara gets down on it and slices it towards point where Head does the fielding.
Swing and a miss! Henriques bangs it short outside off, Chamara looks to go over mid off but misses.
Slower ball outside off, Asela gets across to paddle it to fine leg but is hit on his pads. The ball rolls towards the leg side and the batsmen take a leg bye.
Length ball outside off, dragged through mid-wicket for a single.
Moises Henriques is back into the attack.
Short outside off, cut through point for a couple of runs by AG. These two have kept the visitors in the game.
FOUR! Smart batting! Length from Tye, Gunaratne gets across and pulls it through backward square leg for a boundary. Sri Lanka need 93 more in 55 balls.
Shorter outside off, dabbed towards third man for a single by CK.
Fuller in length, slower, Kapugedera is through his shot early and is beaten.
Slower length ball outside off, Kapugedera gets under it and lofts it over mid-wicket. Dunk gets across from long on and stops the ball. Two runs taken.
Fuller in length on the stumps, dug out towards mid-wicket by the batsman.
Andrew Tye returns for a spell.
CK pulls this length delivery to deep square leg for a single.
Length delivery, outside off, Kapugedera looks to dab but gets beaten.
Shortish delivery, on leg, Gunaratne swivels and pulls it to fine leg. One run added to the total!
Kapugedera cuts it towards point for a single.
FOUR! Sloppy fielding. Length delivery, around leg, Kapugedera pulls it, Turner hares across and misjudges the direction of the ball allowing an easy boundary for the opposition.
Bowls a length delivery, hip height, Kapugedera pulls this through backward square leg for a single.
James Faulkner called back on for a bowl.
Length delivery, outside off, CK looks to cut and misses. Paine collects it on the second bounce.
Good length delivery, on the pads, Gunaratne flicks it through square leg to bring Gunaratne back on the strike. One run added to the total!
Length ball, around off, CK rocks back and cuts it through point. One run added to the total!
Full length delivery, around middle and leg, Gunaratne flicks it uppishly in front of square for a single.
Fuller delivery, around off, Kapugedera strikes it hard and the ball rolls through mid on. One run added to the total!
Length ball, around off, Kapugedera defends it towards the off side.
Pat Cummins returns for a bowl.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
FOUR! CK comes down the track and lofts this floated delivery straight down the ground for a boundary.
Kapugedera cuts it uppishly and Head at point dives forward to catch it but it falls just short of him.
Square leg in place now.
FOUR! Tosses this one outside off, CK kneels and sweeps this cleanly in front of square for a boundary.
Tossed up delivery, around off, Gunaratne looks to sweep, misses. It hits his body and goes towards short third man. They run a leg bye.
Shorter and flatter, CK pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Ashton Turner called back into the attack.
Good length delivery, outside off,  CK drives it towards covers where a misfield allows the Sri Lankan batsmen take a single.
Length ball, around off, Gunaratne again opens the face of the blade and pats it down towards third man. They run a single!
Attempted yorker, outside off, CK opens the face of the bat and guides it down towards third man for a single.
On a length, around middle and leg, Kapugedera works it around towards square leg for a single.
Length ball, around pads, Gunaratne tickles it fine and runs two. It seemed like it came off his pads, but replays show that there some connection.
Fuller delivery, around off, Gunaratne flicks it to the mid-wicket fielder.
Moises called on for a bowl.
Slower and length delivery, around off, Kapugedera cuts it straight to the cover point fielder.
Fuller delivery, around off, Gunaratne plays it very late towards third man and runs one.
Good length delivery, nipping back in, CK knocks it to mid on. One run added to the total!
On a length, around off, Gunaratne defends it with soft hands towards off side and sets off for a run.
Length ball, outside off, Kapugedera cuts it past point for a single.
There is a slight delay as the physio is out attending Chamara Kapugedara. There is a short leg in place now.
Chance? Almost! Length ball, around off, Kapugedera looks to defend it off the back foot but misses and it hits his glove. Fortunately for him, it falls just short of Finch at first slip.
Fuller in length on off, Asela defends it watchfully.
Fuller in length on off, Kapugedera gets it through square leg for a single off the inner half. Chamara actually ran into the bowler, Tye is not impressed.
Short and outside off, Chamara does not feel the need to play at it.
Two slips in place.
Chamara Kapugedera comes out to face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! Tye is on a hat-trick! What are Sri Lanka upto? Short and outside off, Milinda Siriwardana thinks this is a boundary, goes for the cut shot but finds Ashton Turner at point who accepts the catch. This is a poor batting display from the Sri Lankans.
Milinda Siriwardana comes out at the centre.

OUT! Australia are all over Sri Lanka here! Angles it on a back of a length around off, Dilshan Munaweera looks to ride the bounce and get it down to third man but the ball goes off the face of the bat into the hands of the keeper for a simple catch. Sri Lanka are in deep trouble.
WIDE! Tries the cutter but it is way wide outside off, left alone by the batsman.
SIX Poor ball and punished! Short from Tye, angling into the body, Asela gets behind it and just helps it on its way into the fine leg fence for a maximum. Easy as you like from AG!
Andrew Tye introduced into the attack.
FOUR! Thumped! Length ball on off, Munaweera does not care if Sri Lanka have just lost a wicket, he makes room for himself and spanks it between mid off and extra cover for a boundary.
Leading edge! On a length on off, Gunaratne gets a leading edge through covers for a couple of runs.
On a length around off, Asela defends it watchfully.
Asela Gunaratne has arrived at the crease.

OUT! Maiden T20I wicket for Jhye Richardson! Fuller outside off, Mendis goes hard at this one, wanting to drive on the up, he gets an outside edge through to the keeper who goes towards to his right and pouches the catch. The Australain fielders mob Richardson for the wicket.
Outside off, punched towards covers by Mendis. Head gets to the ball and scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end but the non-striker was always in.
Back of a length around off, Mendis gets behind the line of it and defends it watchfully.
Debutant Jhye Richardson is into the attack.
Outside off, Mendis defends it off the outer half towards point for a single.
Shorter outside off, Mendis controls his pull well to get it through backward square leg. The fielder in the deep at square leg, dives well to keep the ball in play. Tye was the fielder, there.
Short outside off, Mendis gets on top of the bounce and slaps it wide of point for a couple of runs.
On a length around off, Mendis defends it from his crease. The bowler has a not-so-friendly shy at the striker's end for no apparent reason.
Kusal Mendis is the new man in.

OUT! That's all for Dickwella! The change of bowling works, Faulkner bowls it around off, Dickwella goes for the scoop but seems to have missed it. The ball lobs to the keeper who takes the catch and appeals. The umpire gives it out but the batsman is not happy, rightly so, that came off his shoulder actually. Dickwella runs out of luck, Faulkner gets one back. He was given out lbw despite getting an inside edge when he was batting. Early strike for him with the ball.
Shorter outside off, Dickwella gets a bottom edge as he looks to cut this one through the off side.
James Faulkner comes into the attack.
FOUR! Take that, Pat! Cummins bowls it short outside off, Dilshan gets over it and slaps it over extra cover for a boundary to get off the mark in style. Expensive over, 17 off it!

Slower shorter one outside off, tapped towards point for a quick single. He adjusted well to the ball there. There was a shy at the striker's end but the no harm done. Replays show had he hit, that would have been out as Dilshan had his bat stuck in the ground as he tried to drag it in.
FOUR! Another lucky boundary! Steams in from 'round the wicket and bangs it short on the stumps, Dickwella goes for the pull but gets it off the top edge down to the third man fence.
Goes round the wicket.
FOUR! Top shot! Shorter in length on the stumps, Dickwella makes room and arches back to get the placement right, gets his punch behind the backward point for a boundary.
On a length on off, Dickwella backs away and slaps it to short extra cover.
Woah! Pat Cummins just slipped in his bowling run up and landed awkwardly at the crease. Thankfully, no harm done.
FOUR! That's how he plays! On an angle going across a shuffling Dickwella, the batsman goes for the whack through covers but gets off the outside edge over the slip cordon for a boundary.
Pat Cummins to bowl from the other end.
Floats it outside off, Dilshan looks to play at it but is beaten all ends up.
Dilshan Munaweera replaces Upul Tharanga at the centre.

OUT! The gamble pays off! Shorter on middle and leg, the arm ball from Turner, Tharanga looks to swing it over the mid-wicket fence but get it off the top half of the bat. Jhye Richardson in the deep settles under the ball and takes it safely. The game to open the bowling with Turner has worked for the hosts. The Sri Lanka skipper has to depart.
Shorter on the stumps, Tharanga punches it to covers.
FOUR! Superb hit! Fuller outside off, Tharanga comes down the wicket and slams it up and over mid off for a boundary.
Floats it on off, Tharanga comes forward and pushes it towards the on side.
Low full toss, Dickwella comes down to hit it through mid-wicket but fails to connect. They take a run as the ball deflects off the boot. The bowler appeals but to no avail.
Welcome back for the chase! Upul Tharanga and Niroshan Dickwella stride out to open the batting for Sri Lanka. Australia begin with Ashton Turner! Here we go...
